name: Abilities that trigger on an ability being activated
blocker: no trigger condition observes an activation

name: Abilities that trigger on another permanent attacking
blocker: the attack trigger condition observes only its own source

name: Abilities that trigger on drawing a card
blocker: trigger conditions observe zone changes, attack declaration, life gain, casting, and step boundaries

name: Attack and block requirements, and blocking an additional creature
blocker: a declaration can be restricted but never required, and a blocker blocks one attacker

name: Auras that enchant a player or land, or move between hosts
blocker: only enchant-creature Auras granting P/T, keywords, or combat restrictions are modeled

name: Casting from a zone other than the hand, the command zone, or a one-turn graveyard permission
blocker: no alternative-cost or zone-specific casting mechanism (flashback, escape, adventure)

name: Combat damage assigned by a value other than power
blocker: every attacker and blocker assigns damage equal to its current power

name: Conditions other than a permanent count, a mill, or a discard
blocker: the intervening-if vocabulary names three questions and grows one variant at a time

name: Cost reduction and cost increase effects
blocker: no cost-modification layer

name: Costs paid by sacrificing or discarding
blocker: activation costs model only tapping and mana

name: Damage prevention
blocker: no prevention shield or damage-replacement layer

name: Effects that ask a player to name a colour, type, or card
blocker: no player choice recorded on a permanent or spell

name: Effects that let a player choose the order of cards put back on a library
blocker: a scry keeps its unchosen cards in their printed order and a look bottoms its rest at random

name: Effects that return cards from a graveyard to a hand
blocker: a targeted creature card returns from a graveyard to the battlefield; there is no graveyard-to-hand effect

name: Effects that untap, or that stop a permanent untapping
blocker: no untap effect and no skipped-untap flag

name: Effects whose amount is derived from anything but a count of permanents
blocker: an amount may scale with a count of permanents; cards in a zone, life totals, and mana values feed nothing

name: Emblems with an activated ability
blocker: an emblem carries static and triggered abilities only; nothing offers a way to activate one

name: Equipment
blocker: no equip action or attachment outside the Aura model

name: Fight, and other effects taking two differently-specified targets
blocker: one effect's target slots all share a single spec, so two differently-specified slots are unwritable

name: Gaining control of a permanent
blocker: no control-change layer

name: Keyword removal and loses-all-abilities effects
blocker: the ability-adding layer only adds abilities

name: Kicker and other optional additional costs
blocker: no optional cost declared on announcement

name: Mana of any colour, and mana filtering
blocker: mana production names one fixed colour or colourless, with or without a spend restriction

name: Maximum hand size modification
blocker: the cleanup discard uses a fixed hand size

name: Modal spells that choose one
blocker: no mode choice on announcement

name: Multi-face cards (transform, modal double-faced)
blocker: the card model has a single face

name: Optional and conditional effects that choose a target
blocker: an optional effect's contents may not target, and neither may a conditional's branches; a wrapper cannot declare the slots of what it wraps

name: Optional costs paid with anything but mana
blocker: an optional effect's cost is a mana payment; sacrificing, discarding, or exiling to pay is unwritable

name: Protection, and evasion that names a subtype or a land type
blocker: a blocking restriction names a colour or a count; there is no protection layer

name: Replacement effects
blocker: no replacement-effect layer in the rules engine

name: Selectors that filter by power or toughness
blocker: no numeric power or toughness threshold in a target, trigger, or mass-effect selector; only a mid-resolution card choice may cap printed power

name: Spells with X in their cost
blocker: mana costs are fixed strings with no X announcement

name: Static abilities that affect anything but creatures their controller controls
blocker: the continuous-effect selector names one class, so a permanent or an emblem may modify no other

name: The legend-rule choice among duplicates
blocker: CR 704.5j applies, but which copy survives is a deterministic policy (the newest) rather than the controller's choice

name: Tokens created attacking, or as copies of another permanent
blocker: a created token enters untapped or tapped and out of combat; there is no copiable-values model

name: Trigger selectors that filter by a keyword
blocker: observed-permanent selectors filter by subtype and controller only
